{{Top}}
[[File:Imperial_Major.jpg|thumb|250px|A major in the Imperial military]]
'''Major''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by ground and commando forces (such as the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]) and also by many [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] corps.

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In the Imperial service, a major ranked between a [[Commander/Legends#Army.2FStarfighter_Ranks|commander]] and a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]]. In the Imperial Army and Stormtrooper Corps, majors were typically battalion commanders, leading units of approximately 600 to 1000 soldiers, while in TIE Fighter formations, they were often the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officers]] of entire wings of 72 fighters, like Major [[Dalgas]]. They also acted as senior advisors and aides to colonels, [[General/Legends|generals]], and [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]]. One of the most prominent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers to hold the rank of major was a clone of [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsman]] [[Grodin Tierce]], who was in virtual command of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] entire military while advising Moff [[Vilim Disra]] and [[Flim (Human)|Flim]] during the [[Caamas Document]] crisis.

In the New Republic, the absorption of personnel from many different militaries with their own traditions may have caused a great deal of confusion in rank structure; but by the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the rank of major had been firmly shifted down a grade to sit between [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]]. In contrast to the Empire, Majors here were often found commanding smaller formations, for instance flights of a few fighters within a squadron unit.

In the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], however, the rank of Major was still borne by [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] commanders like [[Salle Serpa]]. This may indicate a revival or continuance of the Imperial Army usage, but it could also have been a response to the anomalous situation of the entire GAG, including [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and numerous ground units, being commanded by a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] rather than a general or a flag officer.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CoretBhan.jpg|thumb|[[Coret Bhan]], a Major in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]]]
In real-life Anglo-American systems, a major ranks between a [[Wikipedia:Captain|captain]] and a [[Wikipedia:Lieutenant-Colonel|Lieutenant-Colonel]], and this system is used in the later books of the [[New Jedi Order]] storyline. But the Imperial rank seems to be slightly higher, apparently equivalent to a Lieutenant-Colonel in US or UK forces. For instance, Turr Phennir was promoted from captain to commander in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] after the Battle of [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]], but was a major at the Battle of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. This rank hierarchy corresponds to the [http://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Major#Histoire historical French usage] of the Napoleonic Empire.

The [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] novels and comics are ambiguous, perhaps deliberately so, about the exact position of a major in the New Republic hierarchy&mdash;the positions of all the ranks between colonel and captain are left somewhat vague, but a passage in one of the novels shows that at least some majors outrank some commanders during [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Several interpretations are possible, including that the normative rank structure of [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]] up to the formation of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] continued to conform to the Imperial system, with "major" equivalent to "Lieutenant-Colonel" and "(Flight) Commander" equivalent to an Anglo-American Major, albeit perhaps with an additional "Wing Commander" rank as an alternative to major.
